confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregated but conflicting crowd-sourced and index sources (inexpensive meal sources range from about RON 50 to 55 and one outlier near $4; the cocktail figure comes from an older 2023 crowd-sourced estimate). Beer, coffee and meal anchors are rough medians with moderate uncertainty. Wine glass and cocktail are bounded estimates: no restaurant wine-by-the-glass price was found, so wine is inferred from a restaurant bottle price of about RON 150 and cocktail is set relative to beer, with a 2.5x multiplier. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Cluj-Napoca's market and were not checked against live listings or booking pages; July is peak season, so hotel anchors lean toward the upper part of the range. FX is the latest RBA observation found in search results (18 Nov 2026), taken from search snippets that reference the RBA homepage and RSS feed; the F11 table itself was not retrieved.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Romanian university cities with similar tourism profiles (Brasov, Timisoara, Iasi, Sibiu), adjusted for Cluj-Napoca's somewhat higher urban price level, and cross-checked against cost-of-living indexes and crowd-sourced menu data for Cluj-Napoca itself.
